Use case: ui-mockup. Create a highly polished professional product design presentation image, landscape 1536x1024. This is a VISUAL CONCEPT, not a marketing landing page. Russian remote assistance application named «асси». Ordinary people connect to their own computers and help family. The image contains a large flat front-facing desktop APPLICATION SCREEN at left occupying about 72% width, and a separate Android phone UI front-facing at right occupying 23%, both perfectly readable with clear functional controls. Minimal outside presentation margin, matching neutral backdrop. No perspective tilt, no laptop photograph frame, no huge marketing hero, no enterprise sidebar, no billing, no dashboards, no statistics, no fictional performance numbers. Fictional sample data. Use precise tasteful Cyrillic typography, excellent grouping, optical alignment, simple consistent outline icons and comfortable touch targets. App name small in header; concepts must feel like a serious beautifully crafted 2026 consumer utility, original and distinctive. Small outside caption «Визуальная концепция · демоданные». Important primary actions legible. Use the supplied exact Russian phrases where specified, avoid excessive small labels. Produce an actual complete application interface composition, not wireframes.
DIRECTION A: «Рядом». Title outside app «Рядом / помощь близким». A human-centered contact-book UI: airy milk white background, very dark evergreen typography, restrained forest-green action buttons, pale mint selected surfaces, soft peach details in friendly fictional contact avatars. Refined humanist sans with Cyrillic similar to Golos Text. NO purple/blue glows. Desktop window has slim top brand row and simple top navigation «Главная», «Устройства», «История». Main left two-thirds is an unboxed generously spaced contact list under heading «Кому поможем?» and subtitle «Ваши близкие — на расстоянии одного подключения». Three beautifully designed rows: round illustrated human avatar and name «Мама», smaller «Ноутбук · Windows», status «В сети», calm action «Помочь»; second «Папа», «Компьютер · Linux», «Не в сети»; third «Мой MacBook», «macOS», «В сети». Human avatars are small authored textured illustrations, not emojis. Right one-third is a pale mint invitation area with heading «Нужна помощь?», restrained large code «584 209 176», solid green button «Поделиться кодом», and a short explicit consent line «Подключение только с вашего разрешения». Bottom left slim text action «Подключиться по коду →». Spacious yet efficient, no large empty floating hero. Distinct asymmetric layout: contact list is primary, receiving-help panel secondary. Android screen uses same palette: «Кому поможем?», stacked contact rows with large «Помочь» buttons, compact mint receive-help strip below, 3 bottom tabs «Главная», «Устройства», «История». Keep all controls crisp and realistically sized.

DIRECTION B: «Пространство». Title outside app «Пространство / ваши устройства». Spatial yet practical personal device library. Cool porcelain/light gray overall background with white main surface, graphite type, one strong cobalt action color and almost imperceptible cool shadows. Beautiful Cyrillic geometric sans similar to Onest. Desktop is a THREE-ZONE APP: short unobtrusive left column 180px wide showing brand «асси» then «Мои устройства» with three compact selected-device entries: «MacBook Pro», «Домашний ПК», «Pixel 9», each with small clear device outline icon. The majority of main area is one SELECTED DEVICE workspace: upper-left title «MacBook Pro», status «В сети»; centered large tasteful realistic silver laptop object rendering with abstract muted blue landscape wallpaper; below it one confident cobalt button «Подключиться», small text «Личное устройство». The object is recognisable content for this device, not decorative background. Avoid bento grid and avoid three equal device cards. At bottom across main area a simple separate horizontal quick-connect strip: label «Другое устройство», editable code field «Введите код», arrow button. A thin top-right control «Получить помощь» opens own code, indicating hierarchy without a permanent second large panel. Desktop selected-device stage feels like a premium device manager, with purposeful depth and lots of breathing room. Android screen retains top title «Мои устройства», horizontal device selector text tabs «MacBook», «Домашний ПК», «Pixel», then large selected laptop image centered, status «В сети», blue full-width «Подключиться», secondary «Подключиться по коду» and bottom navigation. No marketing slogans, no colorful decorative blobs.

DIRECTION C: «Фокус». Title outside app «Фокус / быстрое подключение». Compact beautiful GRAPHITE launcher interface, not a big enterprise dashboard. Dark charcoal outer ground and warm graphite surface with carefully calibrated 3 tonal layers, white and pale gray readable text, icy-mint main action only. No neon, no glow, no pure black box grid, no sidebar. Cyrillic typography similar to Manrope. Desktop app occupies a moderately wide horizontal 900x650 flat window with rounded 20px corners, subtle material depth and extremely precise thin separators. Small header «асси» at left, a small quiet theme button right. Under header a centered two-item segmented control «Подключиться» (selected) and «Получить помощь». Main primary control is a generous search/input field spanning the width, magnifier at left, placeholder «Имя устройства или код», shortcut hint at right. Below it caption «Недавние подключения», then elegant full-width dense-but-comfortable rows: laptop icon «Мой MacBook» with secondary «macOS», status «В сети», right arrow; monitor «Домашний ПК» with «Windows», status «В сети»; phone «Телефон мамы» with «Android», «Не в сети». Selected first row uses slightly lighter charcoal and an icy mint rounded-square arrow action. Bottom quiet fixed utility strip says «Ваш код 584 209 176» with copy control and consent icon. No mega heading, no marketing tagline, no stats, no giant two-panel connection layout. This is an elegant tactile everyday tool. Android screen uses the same two-segment header, big input, 3 recent rows, bottom own-code area with mint «Поделиться кодом». Ensure phone controls comfortable, all typography visibly legible.
